_comment: Reference only — not consumed by any build. This lists the exact npm packages (and versions known to work) this demo folder needs installed in the HOST Next.js project. See README.md for install instructions.
notes: axios is NOT required — the real VAApis() network layer was replaced with mockApi.ts (no backend calls).
chai is NOT a real dependency — a dead/broken import from the source app, removed during extraction.

This demo assumes the host project already has Tailwind CSS v4 configured (the default in current create-next-app + shadcn setups). If the host project uses Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind at all, see README.md's 'Tailwind v3 / no Tailwind' section.
geist (fonts) is optional — only needed if you want pixel-exact font matching with the source app; the demo works with the host project's existing font.
